exposure_environment: unenrolled default (no Bridge enrollment, no enabled commands, no high-risk certification)

families.notes: Signed manifest, capability states with the pinned contract revision and live Bridge discovery (cached as runtime snapshots only when the running Bridge's openapi_sha256 equals the pin), datasets, sync status, liveness/readiness.
Reports with source, grain, units, scope, coverage and freshness, and the 8 Bridge datasets as daily metric observations; unavailable sources answer explicit blockers, never invented values.
Bounded, zone- and tenant-scoped reads of exact pinned collections with opaque continuation tokens bound to staff/scope/filters; every read audited.

Typed commands only; durable intent and audit before one dispatch; UNKNOWN_OUTCOME settled only by owner readback; TWO_PERSON and R3/R4 need an independent approval (12 h maximum) carried to the Bridge as the approval claim.
Stage A Bridge feed/ACK and dataset pulls (worker) and Stage B derived HQ outbox, ACKs, snapshots and partition/quarantine/gap status.
Per-currency minor units, never summed across currencies; estimated charges are estimates, never invoices or recognized revenue.
Abuse reports, moderation, holds and off-switches; no message, call or meeting content; high-risk actions need a second approver.
Shared cross-product case shape; go-live, app review and publish decisions only through propose, independent decide and run; automated recommendations are never approvals.
Free / Pro / Business plans; draft and submit by editors, approve, activate, roll back and freeze by approvers with a second person; simulations never change prices.
Register and read requests; per-service completion recorded by each owner; nothing personal in HQ views.
Health, incidents, switches and feature switch-on requests (release managers; second approver); switch flips are R4.
